question: Should maintainers preserve this stale branch as the canonical fix for the linked Control UI `/model status` and `/model list` bug, or close/supersede it in favor of a fresh current-main replacement?
rationale: The user bug is valid, but this branch is stale against the current UI path, lacks proof, and implements command semantics that no longer match current docs/shared behavior.

options.title: Fresh current-main replacement
options.body: Close or supersede this branch after preserving any useful tests, then land one narrow fix against the current executor path with documented `list` and `status` behavior.

options.title: Contributor refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, retarget `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-command-executor.ts`, revise the command semantics, and add redacted after-fix Control UI proof.

options.title: Accept summary-only behavior
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the simpler summary behavior, but that should come with explicit docs and compatibility acceptance for changed model-command semantics.

recommendation.title: Fresh current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Close or supersede this branch after preserving any useful tests, then land one narrow fix against the current executor path with documented `list` and `status` behavior.
